backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the RevReel backend, defining all data types (UserProfile, Video, Comment, CarMeet, DirectMessage, Notification, etc.) and including mixins for blob storage and authorization with a hardcoded admin principal.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping feature IDs and titles (profile routing fixes, navigation audits, query hook fixes, etc.) to their relevant source files, components, test IDs, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: A JSON document containing short summaries of each frontend source file, describing the purpose and key fixes applied to components, hooks, and pages in the RevReel frontend.
frontend/index.css: Base Tailwind CSS entry point defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens used throughout the app.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML shell for the RevReel frontend SPA, mounting the React app at the `#root` div and loading the main TypeScript entry point.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Defines the TanStack Router route tree with all app routes (feed, profile with `$userId` param, upload, discover, inbox, messages, meets, builds, classifieds, admin, etc.) wrapped in a QueryClient and ThemeProvider.
frontend/src/components/AuthGuard.tsx: Authentication guard component that shows a loading spinner during initialization, a styled login prompt when unauthenticated, or renders children when the user has a valid Internet Identity.
frontend/src/components/CarMeetCard.tsx: Displays a card for a car meet event with location, date, and attendee info, and allows authenticated users to join or leave the meet via mutation hooks.
frontend/src/components/ChallengeModal.t: A dialog modal that lets the current user select one of their uploaded videos to send as a challenge to another user.
frontend/src/components/CommentsPanel.ts: A slide-in panel that displays sorted comments for a video and allows authenticated users to post new comments.
frontend/src/components/EditProfileModal: A dialog modal for editing the current user's profile, including username, bio, and avatar upload, using the updateProfile mutation.
frontend/src/components/FollowButton.tsx: A button component that toggles following/unfollowing a user, hiding itself when the viewer is the profile owner or unauthenticated.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: The main app shell with a fixed top header, primary and secondary navigation, upload shortcut, profile link, logout, and a profile setup modal trigger for new users.
frontend/src/components/PostIssueModal.t: A modal dialog that allows authenticated users to post a car mechanical issue with a title, category, and description, submitting it via the `useCreateMechanicsPost` mutation.
frontend/src/components/PostListingModal: A modal dialog for authenticated users to create a parts/car listing with fields for title, make, model, year, price, condition, category, and image URL.
frontend/src/components/PostMeetModal.ts: A modal dialog for posting a car meetup event, collecting title, location, date/time, description, and category, then submitting via the `useCreateCarMeet` mutation.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: A mandatory profile setup modal shown to new users, allowing them to set a username, bio, and avatar, then saving the profile via `useSaveCallerUserProfile`.
frontend/src/components/StartBuildLogMod: A modal dialog for authenticated users to start a new car build log by entering a title, car make/model/year, and description, submitted via the `useCreateBuildLog` mutation.
frontend/src/components/VideoCard.tsx: A React component that renders a single video or photo card with controls for liking, reacting, saving, commenting, challenging, and deleting, using TanStack Query mutations and Internet Identity for auth.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: A custom hook that creates and caches an authenticated (or anonymous) ICP backend actor using TanStack Query, invalidating dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an InternetIdentityProvider and useInternetIdentity hook for managing DFINITY AuthClient login/logout state and persisting identity across page reloads.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines all TanStack Query hooks and TypeScript interfaces for interacting with the ICP backend, covering profiles, videos, comments, car meets, messages, notifications, build logs, and marketplace listings.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports Barlow fonts, configures Tailwind with OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for dark/light themes, and defines utility classes for neon text, borders, glows, and glass-card effects.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app wrapped in QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/About.tsx: A static About page for RevReel that displays a hero section, platform description, feature list, and social/donation links with a copy-to-clipboard CashApp tag.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPanel.tsx: Admin panel page that lists all users and allows deletion; shows an access-denied state for non-admins and uses AuthGuard for route protection.
frontend/src/pages/BuildLogDetails.tsx: Detail page for a single build log showing car info, stages, and controls to add a new stage or delete the log (restricted to the author).
frontend/src/pages/BuildLogs.tsx: List page displaying all build logs as cards with car details and stage count, with a button to open the StartBuildLogModal for authenticated users.
frontend/src/pages/CarMeetDetails.tsx: Detail page for a single car meet showing location, date, category, attendees, and a join/leave toggle button for authenticated users.
frontend/src/pages/CarMeets.tsx: List page displaying all car meets using CarMeetCard components, with a button to open PostMeetModal for authenticated users.
frontend/src/pages/Classifieds.tsx: List page showing active classified listings with image, car details, price, and condition, linking to individual listing pages and a post-listing route.
frontend/src/pages/Conversation.tsx: Renders a direct message conversation between the current user and another user, supporting sending, deleting, and auto-marking messages as read, with a scrollable chat UI.
frontend/src/pages/Discover.tsx: Displays a discovery page with a search bar, trending categories, and hashtags derived from all videos, navigating to a filtered feed on selection.
frontend/src/pages/Feed.tsx: Shows a vertically snapping full-screen feed of all videos sorted by newest first, wrapped in an AuthGuard.
frontend/src/pages/FilteredFeed.tsx: Renders a filtered list of videos by either category or hashtag based on URL params, with a back-navigation header.
frontend/src/pages/Inbox.tsx: Displays the user's message inbox as a list of conversation summaries with unread counts, linking to individual conversation pages.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Marketing landing page for RevReel that handles Internet Identity login and redirects authenticated users to the feed.
frontend/src/pages/Leaderboard.tsx: Shows a leaderboard with trending videos and top racers ranked by total likes, computed from all videos data.
frontend/src/pages/ListingDetails.tsx: Displays a single classifieds listing's details including image, price, description, and seller info, with an option for the seller to deactivate/remove the listing via a confirmation dialog.
frontend/src/pages/MechanicsHelp.tsx: Lists all community mechanics help posts with category, date, and comment count, and provides a button to open a modal for posting a new issue.
Shows the full details of a single mechanics help post including comments, allows authenticated users to add comments, and lets the post author delete the post.
frontend/src/pages/Notifications.tsx: Displays a list of user notifications with read/unread state, supports marking individual or all notifications as read, and navigates to the sender's profile on click.
frontend/src/pages/Profile.tsx: Renders a user profile page with avatar, stats, badges, and tabbed views for uploaded videos and saved videos, supporting both own-profile editing and viewing other users' profiles with a follow button.
frontend/src/pages/Upload.tsx: Provides a form for uploading videos or photos with title, description, category, hashtags, and optional thumbnail, tracking upload progress and navigating to the feed on success.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom theme tokens (colors, fonts, shadows, border radii, keyframes) using oklch variables, with typography, container-queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Project state tracking file describing a social media app with a known 'not found' error on the profile page, listing existing fix-request features targeting route configuration, component logic, navigation links, and query hooks.
